issues: Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' — add DialogDescription for a11y (non-blocking).

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to ClientFormModal and UserFormModal to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: quotation.py:140 list_all_bid_packages: N+1 query — for every BidPackage it does 3 separate DB queries (Project.get, Bid.count, BidLineItem.count). For any org with >50 bid packages this will hurt. Prefer a single GROUP BY + JOIN or aggregate in one round-trip.

clients.py:17 list_clients: fine for small N but performs one COUNT query per client for active_projects_count inside a Python loop (N+1). Fold into a single func.count group_by like the total_billed subquery already does.
users_admin.py: create_user password strength is only length-checked (>=6 per spec). No complexity requirement. Consider min 8 chars with mixed complexity for admin-created accounts.

quotation.py:238 vendor_quote allows submission when bp.status in ('Open','Draft'). Draft packages should typically not be biddable (they aren't invited yet). Consider restricting to 'Open' only, or ensure Draft packages never have invitations issued.

Frontend record-payment / reset-password / delete-user use window.prompt/window.confirm — poor UX and untestable via non-dialog-aware tools; replace with shadcn Dialog + form for consistency with rest of app.
finance.py refresh_invoice_status runs on every read — consider running only on payment write to avoid write-on-read side effects.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 new + 53/53 regression from iter3 not re-run this pass)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all documented data-testid + role gating + auto-redirect verified)
